why: 0.34.0 writes an issue after the change it follows, creates one with its text as its own change, and deletes one as a change that can be undone (ISS-7). From the issues switch the relay keeps issues in order for every team and refuses an issue change that names no change it follows, a permanent delete of an issue, and a new project or issue whose first record carries its text (ISS-8). Raise this when the workspace starts expecting something every writer must do; an agent below it refuses writes and still reads.
